proofs.text: Create `<tmp>/a/b/c` with a `.purlin/` marker in `<tmp>/a`; call for the project root with the start directory `<tmp>/a/b/c` and verify it returns `<tmp>/a`

rule_text: Failing that, the root is found by climbing from the start directory to the nearest ancestor holding a `.purlin/` marker directory

tests.body:
def test_climbs_to_purlin_marker(self):
        root = os.path.join(self.tmpdir, 'a')
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(root, '.purlin'))
        deep = os.path.join(root, 'b', 'c')
        os.makedirs(deep)
        result = find_project_root(start_dir=deep)
        assert result == root
tests.name: test_climbs_to_purlin_marker
